assignment_contract: The frozen four-slot role and Path SHA are checked directly at prelaunch and post-Path with validate_frozen_assignment. There is no fixed distinct-Path count per period.
preflight_requirements: Stage the shared validator module and freeze its source SHA in a fresh manifest.
Stage the v3 host source and freeze its SHA in the same manifest.
Verify the staged assignment SHA and each period's four assigned rows before Path publication.
Preserve all prior period provenance and rerun static/synthetic tests before any new runtime authorization.
evidence_policy: Existing period 0/1 host-valid evidence and period 2 offline-audited evidence keep distinct provenance. The original period-2 failed seal is never rewritten.
